event_summary: A tabletop Newton-cradle-like object remains still at first, then its end metal spheres alternately swing away from and back toward the central row.
raw_event_description: The scene opens on a metal-frame cradle with five shiny hanging spheres aligned above a black base on a wooden table. For an extended early interval the spheres appear still and closely aligned. Later, a left-side sphere is visible separated to the left and moving toward the row; after it reaches the row, the right-side sphere is visible separated to the right. The right-side sphere moves outward and then back toward the row. The left-side and right-side end spheres then continue alternating between separated side positions and positions near the central row for several visible cycles, while the central spheres remain close together near the bottom of the frame.

reasons: The cradle frame, base, hanging strings, and aligned metal spheres are visible.
The spheres appear still in the first frame.
The tabletop and surrounding scene are visible.

The left-side separated sphere moves rightward toward the aligned spheres.

The central visible spheres remain close together near the bottom of the frame while end-sphere separations occur.
